description: Hop with the christmas palette (red, green, white), seed 1, brightness 100. The first color is draw 1 mod 3 = 0 (red); each hop draws j = x mod 2 and takes j, or j + 1 from the current index up: white, green, white, green. Each hop dips: from 550 ms of a step down to 400 at the step's end (850 at 600 ms), up again in 150 ms (731.36 at 80 ms).
